description_en: Queries the details of a broadcast device, including the device status and available space
description_zh: 查询播报设备的详情，包括设备的状态、设备的可用空间等
name: GetSpeechDeviceDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This is the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，是设备的唯一标识符。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html可以获取该参数
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
></notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
